scope: Complete sixteenth numbered juan: the Wenyan on Qian and Kun, with every accompanying commentary and source supplement. Not the preface or preliminary juan.
word_count_method: Latin-letter tokens, including apostrophized and hyphenated forms, within source-aligned translated blocks; image markup and endnote references excluded. Includes source titles, attribution labels and source section summaries; excludes added navigation headings, project front matter and endnotes.

collation.type: Selective comparison of transcriptions and visual inspection of selected historical page images.
collation.parallel: Wikisource, Siku Quanshu transcription, Juan Sixteen

selected_facsimiles.purpose: Speech and sincerity; absence of the stray 敏; the Cheng brothers and Zhu’s explanations of knowing and acting.
Lin Xiyuan’s account of sincerity and the difficult wording 道之壺奧; no different reading established.
He Kai’s 柔靜者體也; confirms correction of the base’s 承靜.
The fifth-line commentary, 正位居體; transmitted 物躬 retained.

review.automated_validation_scope: Ordered source coverage, canonical Wenyan versus section summaries and titles, commentarial roles, source supplement, notes, images, word counts and checksums; not proof of semantic accuracy or literary quality.
